notes.title: The Chant Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h2]Our Dear Community,[/h2]

[i]We want to apologize once again for any technical issues you might have experienced with the Steam version of the DLC. The matter should now be resolved and you should be able to install it now. Thank you for your understanding and patience and enjoy the new content.[/i]

This week, we are not only releasing a new DLC for our players but also introducing a significant number of major improvements to the base game, enhancing the overall experience with more depth and diversity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/f20796c1e95cb547b1d0e757a02e8f90006d087e.jpg[/img]

[h2]You can find more details about the list of improvements below:[/h2]

[h3]Revised Mind Body Spirit Experience System[/h3]
[list]
[*]Enemies are now classified as either Mind, Body, or Spirit
[*]Mind, Body, or Spirit experience is gained from defeating each enemy type
[*]Weapons and Abilities do extra damage if they match the same class of enemy
[*]Enemies now have color-coded health meters based on experience type
[*]Tuned overall mind body and spirit experience to make endings more equally distributed[/list][h3]Improved AI[/h3]
[list]
[*] Enemies are more observant and responsive
[*] Enemies can chase the player further
[/list][h3]Combat Improvements[/h3]
[list]
[*] More smooth and responsive auto targeting
[*] More accurate collision for player and enemy attacks
[/list][h3]Visuals[/h3]
[list]
[*] Gloom colors are more vibrant and clear
[/list][h3]* Steam Only:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Improvements to mitigate hitching on all quality presets 
[/list][i][h3]Our team is always working hard to make the game better for you. We're stoked about this update and hope you'll have a blast with it![/h3][/i]
[h3]Sincerely,
Brasstoken [/h3]

notes.title: DLC The Gloom Below is OUT NOW! Redeem it for free!
notes.content:
[h2]Hey there,[/h2]

We're excited to share that [b]"The Gloom Below"[/b], the DLC for The Chant, is [b]OUT NOW[/b], and you can manually redeem it through the Steam store for free. This DLC continues the story after the events of The Chant, shedding light on Jess's journey and delving deeper into the history of Prismic Science.

In "The Gloom Below," you'll embark on a new adventure after escaping the eerie challenges of Glory Island. You'll venture into a surreal realm where The Gloom intertwines with the real world. Collaborating with the Anton Family and uncovering the stories of trapped cultists, players will face unexpected challenges while collecting unique items to combat The Gloom. If you haven't joined the spiritual session, now is the ideal moment to immerse yourself in The Gloom and explore a twisted world of cosmic horror.

[previewyoutube=KPrMI-hiouU;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]The gameplay of The Gloom Below [/h3]

This expansion offers a challenging new structure that encourages replayability and experimentation to survive. Death provides its rewards as you return to the Nexus to upgrade your abilities and earn new weapons. Drain the energy from Monroe and his acolytes to unlock 18 new ability modifiers, enabling powerful combinations for damaging, evading threats, or immobilizing adversaries. Each creature you encounter presents distinct vulnerabilities that require creative exploitation.

[h3]New Content[/h3]

This expansion enriches the lore, enhances your abilities, and introduces new weaponry, ingredients, and, of course, new enemies. The gameplay emphasizes action and combat, offering plenty of thrilling moments. With the Gloom eroding Jess' sanity, her mind and body are under constant threat. New entities lurk in the shadows, and brutal creatures relentlessly hunt you down. To survive, you must fight hard and think strategically, managing your inventory and adapting tactics. Bring down a host of teleporting Hyperleeches with the power of plasma as you charge up the iridescent blade to slice through the evasive Skulks.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/f84110899aba9a0eb31d70c32ccc66706ef17bbc.gif[/img]

[h3]Main Game Improvements[/h3]

But that's not all; with this release, we've included a list of significant improvements to the base game! We've revised the Mind Body Spirit experience system, enhanced AI and combat mechanics, and improved the visual experience by making the colors in The Gloom world more vibrant and distinct.

[h2][h3]How to redeem your DLC version[/h3][/h2]

To redeem your free DLC for The Chant, you need to own the base game. Then, you can redeem it on the DLC store page using the following link: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2190430/The_Chant__The_Gloom_Below/

[i][h3]That is all for now, we hope you will enjoy your adventure in The Gloom! [/h3]

[h3]Sincerely,
Brass Token Team[/h3]
[/i]

notes.title: "The Gloom Below" - FREE DLC Announcement
notes.content:
[h2]Greetings to our community,
[/h2]

Did you miss the opportunity to join the spiritual retreat, or are you eagerly anticipating a return to the Gloom to unveil its secrets? We have thrilling news for you – the [b]DLC "The Gloom Below"[/b] is on the horizon, shedding light on the story's continuation after the events of the Mind Ending in "The Chant." It's set to be released on 12 September.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/43f2e6f0728146b82d3b6d977806ec22414a3d98.gif[/img]

"The Gloom Below" takes players on the next leg of their adventure, following their escape from the horrors of Glory Island, deep into a surreal and twisted fusion of The Gloom and the physical world. Collaborating with the cursed Anton Family and following the stories of trapped cultists, players must fight their way through unpredictable encounters and gather the ingredients necessary to destroy the heart of The Gloom. 

The new content will add additional lore, upgraded abilities, new weapons and some new enemies too, as well as having significant focus on the combat and action elements of the game, giving users many more hours of horrific pleasure; each death leads players closer to their escape so finding the right build will be essential.

[previewyoutube=u9h8j_wSLnI;full][/previewyoutube]
[i][h5]But there's even more exciting news! The[b] DLC will be FREE [/b]for everyone who owns the main game! For those who have yet to experience “The Chant” and to celebrate the release of the DLC, we are permanently reducing the price of the main game, so there is no better time to get into the cosmic horrors of Glory Island on 12 September. [/h5][/i]

notes.title: The Chant - Hotfix Patch 1.4.1
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/0481df91d36c7fcfb3c940e6b7180c8524b7f099.png[/img]

This patch includes some important combat targeting changes that aim to create a smoother and more responsive experience for our players. For those who have played the game before, we believe these changes will feel quite fresh. Let us know what you think.

Your feedback is much appreciated and has served as a basis for the priorities addressed in today’s update and the hotfixes which preceded it.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42433966/e1694385f6b11bac26415cb3dfb6653d874c871e.png[/img]

[b]Combat Targeting Tuning to create a smoother and more responsive experience for our players:[/b]
[list]
[*] Camera now remains consistent when sprinting in combat.
[*] Camera is more responsive to player input when camera auto-targeting is used in combat.

notes.title: Хрупкая девушка против порождений сумрака: Обзор The Chant
notes.content: Небольшие инди-студии делают куда больше для хоррор-жанра, чем многие именитые издатели. И речь идет о проектах, которые, не обладая большим бюджетом или командой, создаются с любовь к деталям и настоящей атмосфере ужаса. Я уже восхищался Song of Horror и Tormented Souls, каждая из которых подарила поклонникам этого направления массу оригинальных идей и ностальгических решений. The Chant от канадской студии Brass Token эксплуатирует наработки оригинального Alone in The Dark, предлагая игрокам путешествие в загадочный мир тайных сект и зловещих измерений.

notes.title: Resident Evil meets Midsommar in Steam horror game The Chant
notes.content:
"Kim, doesn't this all feel a little bit culty?" Steam horror game The Chant brings together the mystical intrigue and interpersonal drama of Life is Strange, the 'mysterious cult gone wrong' vibes of folk horror film Midsommar, and the tense third-person action-adventure game stylings of games such as Resident Evil, The Evil Within, and The Last of Us. Best of all, you can play it right now.

notes.title: Behind the Music and Sound with Paul Ruskay
notes.content:
Greeting spiritualists,

Today we’re giving you a deeper insight into the immersive soundscapes of The Chant, featuring Audio Director Paul Ruskay and Creative Director Mike Skupa, ahead of our upcoming release on November 3rd!

[previewyoutube=qv0GvFQE1Ao;full][/previewyoutube]

Paul Ruskay has been a leading audio producer of music and sound design for the video game, film and advertising industries for the past 26 years. Knowing well how to invoke horror, Paul has been deeply influenced by cult horror classic soundtracks from the 70s. 

Human beings respond to fear in a physical way, particularly when playing a horror game, so we want our music and sound design to really bring your experiences on Glory Island to life. Paul Ruskay’s approach was to pay homage to the classics of the 70s and 80s, utilising analogue instruments to stay true to the game’s natural, spiritual setting, while also keeping things feeling fresh through dynamic effects and creature sounds.

Welcome to the Prismic Science Spiritual Retreat on remote Glory Island. Discard your baggage from the past and transform your Gloom to Glory!
